execution: App-managed JSON tool calls; explicit camera queries use a deterministic fast path. At most one read-only tool is executed per question.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Capture a current camera frame and detect object labels, directions and confidence; does not measure distance.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Read up to 1600 characters from a current camera frame using local OCR.

example.question: Di depan saya ada apa?
example.spoken_answer: Terdeteksi kursi di depan. Jarak belum diukur.
